reviewer_binding.method: Fresh read of frozen WP0-WP7 evidence and governing DSAI/GRT sources; no live pipeline writes; challenge false-allow, stale-evidence, mutable-metadata and over-recovery failure modes.

inputs: DSAI v0.3 VIT design/ratified implementation plan

A01.basis: 20/20 corpus records frozen; exact missing sub-evidence is typed NOT_EVALUABLE

A03.basis: zero false authority allows across canonical, historical and perturbation replay

A04.basis: source-explicit main-movement cases classified placement-only/selective renewal; no assumption applied where exact frontier evidence missing

A05.basis: WP3/WP4 preserve A0 assurance independently from placement failure

A06.basis: rerun creates new immutable assurance generation; prior evidence is not overwritten

A07.basis: PR metadata excluded from authoritative shadow identity

A08.basis: semantic dispatch key deduplicates identical integration demand

A09.basis: Git object/graph proof remains normative under API degradation; absent Git proof fails closed

A10.basis: Merged controls reproduce source-explicit admission/tree expectations where exact A3 evidence is available; absent historical post-merge sub-evidence is NOT_EVALUABLE and is not inferred.

A11.basis: No live workflow, ruleset, required check, VIT/SIQ/GRT admission or physical main write was performed by PRVIT; active ruleset 20229411 remains unchanged.

A12.basis: This independent adversarial review finds no unresolved safety-class warning; residual limitations concern historical evidence completeness and future migration risk, not false authority allowance.

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Could AA0 reuse mask a dependency change?
adversarial_challenges.reason: Reuse is permitted only when PIP/harness/dependency/authority frontier remains unchanged; WP6 dependency mutation escalates renewal.

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Could typed BLOCKED_UPSTREAM be treated as PASS?
adversarial_challenges.reason: Required assertions contribute only explicit PASS; NOT_APPLICABLE/BLOCKED/STALE cannot satisfy admission.

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Could immutable lineage dual-read accidentally weaken current live protection?
adversarial_challenges.reason: WP7 explicitly requires dual-read comparison with current live route authoritative until separate operator cutover.

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Could PR metadata still grant authority through a pointer?
adversarial_challenges.reason: Pointer is non-authoritative; missing immutable record fails closed.

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Could placement-only recovery cross an operator gate?
adversarial_challenges.reason: Authority frontier is an independent invalidation plane; changed/missing operator authority escalates AUTHORITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Could closeout consolidation hide post-merge facts?
adversarial_challenges.reason: Post-write commit/tree remain in content-addressed PhysicalMaterialisationReceipt/PacketCompletionReceipt; exact live implementation still requires later proof.

residual_risks: Live dual-read migration could surface undocumented consumers of PR-body lineage.
Reordering tests.yml dependency graph may alter GitHub UX/check timing even when semantics are preserved.
Exact typed-assurance schema versioning and retention policy must be frozen before live cutover.
Historical cohort covers a concentrated incident window rather than all repository history; broader rollout should retain shadow comparison after cutover.
